origin.description: Get or set the nice value.

arguments.name: pid
arguments.text: Process id. The default is this process.

arguments.name: value
arguments.text: NA reads the nice value. An integer sets it.

origin.details: The value returned when setting is the nice value from before the change. The next read sees the new value.
origin.value: The nice value. Invisible when setting.

translation.description: Get or set the nice value.

arguments.name: pid
arguments.text: Process id. The default is this process.

arguments.name: value
arguments.text: NA reads the nice value. An integer sets it.

translation.details: os.getpriority and os.setpriority. None reads. An integer sets, and the return value is the nice value from before the change.
translation.value: The nice value from before a set, or the current value when reading.
